_docs.splash_url: oMLX/Splash OpenAI server base URL (default http://localhost:8000)
_docs.omlx_home: oMLX home dir holding logs/, usage.sqlite3, stats.json (default ~/.omlx)
_docs.omlx_log: Optional: exact path to the oMLX server log (default {omlx_home}/logs/server.log)
_docs.omlx_usage_db: Optional: exact path to oMLX usage.sqlite3 (default {omlx_home}/usage.sqlite3)
_docs.omlx_stats: Optional: exact path to oMLX stats.json (default {omlx_home}/stats.json)
_docs.hermes_state_db: Hermes state.db. 'auto' (default) = most recently active profile; or an explicit path like ~/.hermes/profiles/<name>/state.db
_docs.db_path: Where ModelPulse stores its own persistent DB (default ~/modelpulse/pulse.db)
